extra.final_summary:
I analyzed the penguin dataset to determine how many penguins were measured on each island. 

Key issues found and fixed:
1. Duplicate row (row 49) was removed
2. whitespace issue in island name " Biscoe" was fixed by trimming and normalizing to "Biscoe"
3. Out-of-range body mass value (3625000) in row 0 was excluded as it exceeded the allowed range of 2500-6500
4. Body mass column was converted from text to numeric to enable proper calculations

The final counts of penguins measured on each island are:
- Biscoe: 21 penguins
- Dream: 25 penguins
- Torgersen: 4 penguins
